purpose: isolate startup timestep failure from added fault instrumentation
result: The retained passing cases are combined transformations: direct Dboost1/2 reconnection plus removal of both zero-volt diode sense sources/fields, with no-f2-sense also changing Vf2sense to 1 mV. They complete 10 ms, while the retained schedule-only and Vbody-1mV controls still fail at the same point. No individual causal change is isolated and no marker-removal case was run.
provenance_note: no-diode-sense and no-f2-sense were rewritten in place; parent observed earlier intermediate failures at 24920 and 24758 rows respectively, but those cases/logs have no retained hashes and are not reproducible evidence
directory_label_correction: no-marker is a historical directory name; the retained case is Vbody 0 V -> 1 mV and retains the marker
